The main takeaway from our work is that
the problem of FakeNews Detection is not only a classification problem but also a task that requires the modeling of the internal structure of the input data.
the problem of Fake news detection requires more attention to its specificities and cannot be treated as a generic Stance Detection task, as it has been the case so far.
a cross-level stance detection model is a key component for Fake News Detection and should be considered as an essential building block for any future work on this problem.
